data.title: 春寺由梨亚 · 私寓深夜的黑咖啡温香与摘镜眷恋
data.description: 【春寺由梨亚 · 私寓深夜的黑咖啡温香与摘镜眷恋】高层私密公寓温暖幽暗的开放式厨房吧台前，手冲咖啡壶升腾着浓醇焦香热气。褪去长官防备的JB，鼻梁上的红框眼镜已摘下叠放在大理石台面上。她身上套着一件宽大的男式白衬衫，半边领口慵懒滑落露出雪白圆润的香肩与黑色蕾丝边缘。修长性感的黑丝美腿交叠踩在吧台踏板上，双手捧着白瓷咖啡杯轻吹热气，深蓝眸子泛着罕见的疲惫与化不开的柔情——「雄二，平安回来就好……今晚不聊任务，喝完这杯咖啡……就早点去休息吧。」
data.location: 高层私寓开放式厨房暖光吧台前
data.action: 摘下红框眼镜放在台面，身穿宽松白衬衫单肩滑落捧咖啡杯，黑丝长腿交叠，眼神深情温柔
data.lighting: 吧台上方低色温暖黄吊灯光斑与窗外微弱星夜天光
data.camera: medium shot, seated side 3/4 perspective, intimate tender framing
data.promptProse: A wonderfully intimate and tender slice-of-life anime illustration of Harudera Yuria (JB) from The Fruit of Grisaia relaxing at her apartment kitchen counter late at night. Her signature red-framed glasses are set aside on the marble counter, revealing her exquisite bare face, gentle sapphire-blue eyes, and delicate beauty mark under her right eye. Wearing an oversized white dress shirt casually slipping off one bare shoulder over black lace lingerie, she cradles a ceramic mug of steaming black coffee with both hands, looking at her lover with weary, deeply affectionate tenderness. Warm amber pendant light glow, sheer black pantyhose on crossed legs, cozy midnight domestic atmosphere, clean linework, no text.
